## Document AI (local, no cloud API)

- **Private invoice AI** ([GitHub](https://github.com/SaidIbenariba/private-invoice-ai)): Invoices, scans and phone photos to validated data. Local vision-language model (Ollama), 9 business checks, Excel export, review screen.
- **Order intake AI** ([GitHub](https://github.com/SaidIbenariba/order-intake-ai)): Customer order emails, PDFs and phone photos to ERP-ready orders. Every line matched to a catalog SKU, 0 wrong auto-matches on a held-out test.
- **Contract Q&A AI** ([GitHub](https://github.com/SaidIbenariba/contract-qa-ai)): Answers with exact quotes and page citations. Local RAG (Docling + hybrid retrieval + Qwen2.5 on Ollama), tested on held-out CUAD contracts.

## Machine learning

- **Arabic hate speech detection** ([GitHub](https://github.com/SaidIbenariba/AraHateSpeech_Detection_Twitter_Master2)): Fine-tuned AraBERT and MorrBERT on Arabic tweets, with custom normalization and tokenization for dialectal variation.
- **Skin cancer classification** ([GitHub](https://github.com/SaidIbenariba/Skin_Cancer_Classification)): CNN with transfer learning and targeted augmentation for class imbalance on dermatoscopic images.
